summary: Defines an X.509v3 certificate extension that lets a certificate say which TLS features a server must support. A main use is requiring OCSP stapling, so a client can fail immediately if a status response is not stapled, which prevents downgrade attacks that strip revocation checking.

eli5.summary: A certificate can carry a note saying 'this website must always show its fresh safety check'. If the check is missing, the browser knows something is wrong.
